purpose: FAIL-inclusive follow-up to the narrow all-PASS bias experiment

selection_rule.required_original_user_labels: V01-V30 with explicit PASS/FAIL, case coverage and source fingerprints verified before selection
selection_rule.fail_selection: Up to 6 FAIL cases, first one per task sorted by task_id and case; fill remaining FAIL slots by case ID
selection_rule.pass_selection: Same number of PASS controls, first one per task sorted by task_id and case; fill remaining slots by case ID
selection_rule.shortfall: If no FAIL labels, do not run. If either class has fewer than 6, use the smaller available class size for both classes and report the reduced scope. Do not create labels or substitute judge verdicts.

repeat_control: Unchanged base repeat; report stochastic flips beside changed-variant flips
few_shots: Historical train cases and original contents/order; reverse order only in reversed_examples
final_preflight: Check later user restrictions and explicit authorization before calls
Resolve conflicting human labels/policy decisions before any affected analysis
Record source commit, exact selected cases and frozen hashes before new verdicts
Verify free-tier status and quota; $0, no billing card or paid/provider fallback
Use unique experiment output directory; never overwrite previous records
Preserve partial output on quota/error and score complete matched cases only
reporting_limits: No test or judge accuracy claim from this targeted retrospective selection
Human FAIL selection does not guarantee the judge will produce any FAIL verdicts
Historical rubric contamination remains; labels must not change the frozen rubric
Small targeted subset and one repeat cannot isolate bias causally
Example-order sensitivity is not candidate-answer position bias
Answer repetition is a verbosity stress test, not semantic invariance proof
Original v2 source traces are Groq-generated; separate Gemini agent experiments are not independently validated here
